description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO within the OrangeHRM reporting module. The class encapsulates a DateTime object and provides a method to convert it to a string using a helper trait.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO
classes.description: A data transfer object for representing date fields in report display, with string conversion capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with an optional DateTime object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string using the helper trait.
